title: Good-time music or great music
summary: He thinks most listeners treat New Orleans jazz as good-time dance music, like rhythm and blues, with a few appreciating it more deeply.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: We'd say that the attitude, most of the people that listen to New Orleans jazz now is, that it's just something to dance to, and have a good, accompany a good time, or what they think of it as great music. And I think some people think of classical music as great music.

I think some people think of, uh, Dixieland, and when you say Dixieland, I take it, you mean the, uh, New Orleans music. New Orleans jazz. I think some of them would, would listen to it as an odd poem, which is, I believe, would you, but, uh, I think the majority of them would just listen to it as good time music, just in more or less the same spirit as they'd listen to the rhythm and blues.
